title: Prove the HTTP adapter in CI without a live model host
narrative: It is late and the local inference host is offline for maintenance, but a pull request still needs green CI. Nubble refuses to block merges on network reachability. He wants the OpenAI-compatible path proven from a cassette — a recorded reply replayed through the real HTTP client — so the pipeline stays honest about wire shape without needing a live model. When static CI is green, the adapter is safe to merge; when someone breaks the adapter, CI fails before production.
implementation: `OpenAICompatStrategy` implements the OpenAI-compatible chat completions wire against `httpx`, shared by named backends (openai, vllm, ollama, lmstudio, junespark). The strategy is a real HTTP client path: request and response shapes are part of the library contract, not a test double. Hosts bind it through `MechaHarnessConfig` / `Settings` backend selection.
validation: Same kind `pass_through` on `openai_compat` model trees. Static mode mounts recorded `response.json` via httpx mock transport so the real strategy code runs. Soft expects: non-empty assistant text. Live mode: `MECHA_STORY_BACKEND=live` against `MECHA_BASE_URL`. Cassette fixtures under `tests/fixtures/models/openai_compat/*/v1/stories/nubble_ci_static_smoke/`.
